items.followUp: Write the truth table for the OR operator.

rubric.why: A truth table covers every possible combination of inputs.
rubric.description: States that a truth table lists the possible input combinations.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it lists all possible input combinations.

rubric.why: A truth table shows the output for each input combination and helps analyse logical behaviour.
rubric.description: States that a truth table shows corresponding outputs or is used to analyse a logical expression or circuit.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the corresponding output or the use of the table to analyse logical behaviour.

modelAnswer: A truth table lists all possible combinations of inputs and the corresponding output.
It is used to show or analyse the behaviour of a logical expression or circuit.
